questions.question: Describe the importance of public health in society.
questions.solution_html:
• Public health is important as it focuses on prevention, awareness, and community
  • well-being.
  • 17a. Definitions of health are shaped by social factors like culture, class, and norms.
  • Different societies interpret health based on their values and lived realities.
  • 17b. Pandemics are large-scale disease outbreaks affecting populations globally. They create
  • health crises with major social, economic, and political consequences.
  • 18a. The conflict perspective views healthcare as shaped by inequality and power relations. It
  • highlights unequal access and dominance of elite groups in health systems.
  • 18b. Kerala’s better health indicators result from high literacy, strong public health systems
  • and social development. Effective policies and community participation also contribute
  • significantly.
  • 19a. Social medicine is important as it integrates social factors into healthcare practices. It
  • emphasizes prevention and community-based health approaches.
  • 19b. Technological development has improved diagnosis, treatment, and access to care.
  • However, it has also increased costs and widened inequalities in healthcare.
  • 20a. From a functionalist perspective, healthcare institutions maintain social stability by
  • treating illness. They help individuals return to their normal social roles.
  • 20b. Medicalization expands medical control over everyday life and behaviour. While it
  • improves treatment, it may also pathologize normal human conditions
